q: Does a flue gas desulphurisation unit add CO2 at a coal power plant?
title: FGD limestone: the extra CO2
short: Yes, a little. Wet limestone scrubbers release the carbon in the limestone: 0.44 tonnes of CO2 per tonne of limestone, or about 0.69 tonnes per tonne of SO2 removed. It is small next to the coal, but it is a real process emission and should be reported, along with the scrubber's power use.
audience: Thermal power plants fitting FGD under India's SO2 norms, and auditors checking their inventories

p: Limestone (calcium carbonate) reacts with SO2 and oxygen to make gypsum and releases CO2. Each 100 kg of carbonate gives 44 kg of CO2.

ul: Process CO2: tonnes of limestone used x purity x 0.44.
Electricity for fans, pumps and mills inside the unit, already in auxiliary consumption.
Gypsum sold to cement or board makers carries no share of the CO2.

p: For typical Indian coal with low sulphur, the scrubber adds well under 2 percent to the plant's CO2, but leaving it out understates Scope 1.
